title: Pre-Compressed Static Assets, Transparent Decompression Fallback & HTTP Cache Headers
summary: Implements automated build-time gzip pre-compression for vendor JavaScript assets, transparent server-side decompression fallbacks for non-gzip clients, long-lived HTTP cache control headers, and comprehensive static asset unit tests.

categories.name: Static Asset Compression & Delivery
items: Pre-compress vendor JavaScript assets using gzip level 9 during the web build process to minimize network payloads
Transparently serve pre-compressed assets with Content-Encoding: gzip and Vary: Accept-Encoding headers when supported by the client
Dynamic decompression fallback serves uncompressed payloads to legacy clients that do not negotiate gzip compression
Set immutable cache control headers (Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable) and accurate MIME content types for static vendor responses
Add unit test assertions verifying static asset serving, compression negotiation, and transparent decompression fallbacks
